0022600219.text: The Boston Celtics, 9-2 and first in the East, visit the Toronto Raptors (5-5, sixth in the East) on the road after a 4-2 road record and a four-game winning streak, with a 9-1 record over their last ten. Toronto is missing Kawhi Leonard (knee inflammation), Nate Bittle (foot fracture), and Scottie Barnes (groin soreness), while Collin Murray-Boyles (illness), Immanuel Quickley (hamstring), and Trayce Jackson-Davis (illness) are day-to-day with game-time decisions. The Celtics won the 2025-26 season series 4-0, including a 115-101 win in Boston on April 5, and this season's series has no games yet.
